notes:
Summary: ReelStack manages a 45M-item media archive (video transcriptions + long-form articles). Primary goal: replace brittle keyword search with RAG-driven relevance search for newsroom and legal discovery teams. Key constraints: very long documents (avg 8k-12k chars), high index scale (approx 300M chunks at 1k-token chunking), and strict latency/cost SLAs.

Recent meetings / quotes:
- 2026-02-18 kickoff call (ff-2026-02-18-REELSTACK-1): CTO Jamal R. — "If search takes longer than a browser refresh our reporters lose patience. p95 should be under 400ms for primary workflows."
- AE Sofia: demoed Redwood Dedicated routing and autoprefix caching. Positive reaction to rollout/fallback policies.
- SE James: walked through FAISS HNSW options; recommended sharding by corpus year to improve locality.

Technical details discussed:
- Index scale: 45M docs -> ~300M chunks with naive fixed-size chunking (1k tokens w/128 token overlap). Exploring hierarchical chunking to reduce candidate set size.
- Chunk strategy options on table: fixed-token (1k/512) vs semantic (sentence/paragraph boundaries) vs chapter-aware for transcripts. Need experiment plan.
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-d open model for cost; evaluating contrastive fine-tune on in-house relevance labels.
- Retrieval: ANN layer (FAISS HNSW self-hosted on Dedicated) + candidate set size target 50-100. Want configurable TTL caching for hot queries.
- Reranker: leaning to a small cross-encoder fine-tuned on 5k labeled pairs (editor relevance). Latency budget for reranker is 120-180ms at p95 on Dedicated GPU. Evaluating distilled bi-encoder + light cross-encoder cascade to balance cost.
- End-to-end target: 150-350ms median depending on query type; strict p95 < 400ms for UI queries; batch/legal exports allowed to be higher.
- Cost goals: target $0.002-$0.01 per served query (retrieval + rerank) at production volume (500-1k qps peak for newsroom). Primary concern is cost per query at 1k qps sustained.

POC asks from ReelStack:
- 2-week Dedicated POC with FAISS HNSW + Redwood reranker pipeline including KV-prefix caching and autoscaling burst to test 1k qps.
- Provide sample evaluation harness and suggestion for chunking variants to A/B (fixed-512, fixed-1k, semantic).
- Help define 3 relevance-focused eval sets: editorial search, legal discovery, cold-start queries.
- Security questionnaire: SOC2 + KMS integration details (drive/ReelStack/security-faq-2026.docx).

Risks / notes:
- Labeled data scarcity: need at least 5k-10k high-quality pairs for reliable reranker fine-tune. May need SE to coordinate editorial labeling sprint.
- Index size implies heavy storage IO; recommend node sizing guidance (GPUs + NVMe) in POC.
- Client mentions previous vendor lock-in fear; prefer architecture that allows switching vector index provider behind Redwood routing.

Next actions (short):
- Deliver POC plan + cost model by 2026-03-15 (owner Sofia).
- SE James to prepare sample FAISS shard topology and estimated VM sizes.
- Get security SOW to ReelStack security team (Maria supporting).

Stubs/refs: pricing deck (drive/ReelStack/reelstack-pricing-deck-v2.pdf), sample data (drive/ReelStack/poc-reranker-data-sample.csv), jira INF-2381 tracks initial perf regression on cross-encoder baseline.
